chunks: People are equal like the teeth of a comb.

key_terms.أَسْنَانِ اَلْمُشْطِ: the teeth of a comb; a simile for equal alignment and sameness

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean when it says people are equal like the teeth of a comb?
ai.summary: This saying of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teaches the fundamental equality of people. It emphasizes that human beings share an equal worth and should not be regarded with arrogance or unjust distinction.
